title.en: Your engine wants to be hot #shorts

description.en: How an engine thermostat works: a wax pellet that opens the coolant flow at operating temperature.
description.id: Cara kerja termostat mesin: pelet lilin yang membuka aliran coolant saat suhu kerja tercapai.

scenes.en: Your engine *wants to be hot*, but not too hot.
Burning fuel makes more heat than metal can survive, so coolant *carries it away*.
scenes.id: Bensin yang terbakar menghasilkan panas melebihi daya tahan logam, jadi coolant *membawanya pergi*.

scenes.en: A pump pushes coolant through channels in the engine, then through a *radiator*.
scenes.id: Pompa mendorong coolant lewat saluran di mesin, lalu lewat *radiator*.

scenes.en: But a cold engine wears faster and wastes fuel, so it *needs to warm up first*.
scenes.id: Tapi mesin dingin lebih cepat aus dan boros, jadi ia *harus hangat dulu*.

scenes.en: The thermostat holds coolant inside the engine until it reaches around *90 degrees Celsius*.
scenes.id: Termostat menahan coolant di dalam mesin sampai suhunya sekitar *90 derajat Celsius*.

scenes.en: Inside is a *wax pellet* that melts and expands, pushing the valve open.
scenes.id: Di dalamnya ada *pelet lilin* yang meleleh dan memuai, mendorong katup terbuka.

scenes.en: In its simplest form: no electronics, just wax. Follow for more.
scenes.id: Dalam bentuk paling sederhana: tanpa elektronik, cuma lilin. Follow untuk video lainnya.
